senses.gloss: शिला- + अपिधान शिला- + अपिधान, adj., f. ना, covered by stones, Rām. 3, 76, 35.
शिला- + उच्चय शिला- + उच्चय, m. a mountain, Kir. 5, 10.
शिल- + उञ्छ शिल- + उञ्छ, m. gleaning ears and grains, Man. 7, 33.
शिला- + जतु शिला- + जतु, n. 1. bitumen. 2. red chalk.
शिला- + तल शिला- + तल, n. the surface of a stone.
शिला- + धातु शिला- + धातु, m. 1. chalk. 2. red chalk.
शील-ज्ञान- + निधि शील-ज्ञान- + निधि, m. a virtuous and learned person.
शिला- + पट्ट शिला- + पट्ट, m. 1. a rocky seat, Rām. 2, 105, 6 Gorr. 2. a flat stone for grinding condiments.
शिला- + पट्टक शिला- + पट्टक, m. a rocky seat, Mālav. 31, 21.
शिला- + पुत्र शिला- + पुत्र, m. a muller or roller for grinding condiments on a flat stone.
शिला- + फलक शिला- + फलक, n. a layer or table of stone.
शिली- + मुख शिली- + मुख, m. 1. a bee, Śiś. 9, 41. 2. an arrow, ib.; MBh. 6, 3910. 3. a fool. 4. war.
शील- + वृत्ति शील- + वृत्ति, f. virtue, Pañc. ii. d. 154.
शिला- + वृष्टि शिला- + वृष्टि, f. hail.
शिल्प- + शाला शिल्प- + शाला, n., and f. ला, a workshop.
† शिल् शिल्, सिल् सिल्, i. 6, Par. To glean (cf. the next).

शील् शील् (probably a denomin. derived from the next), i. 1, Par.
 1. † To meditate.
 2. To adore, to worship.
 --Caus., and i. 10, Par.
 1. To make, Gīt. 9, 6.
 2. To practise, Mṛcch. 34, 19.
 3. To visit, Gīt. 7, 4.
 4. To worship, MBh. 1, 3207.
 5. To put on, to dress, Gīt. 5, 11.
 6. † To repeat.
 7. † To surpass.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शीलित, Skilled, conversant.
सिल् सिल्, see शिल्.

शिल शिल,
 A. n. Gleaning ears of corn, Man. 3, 100; 10, 112.
 B. i. e. probably शो + ल,
 I. f. ला.
 1. A stone, Pañc. 100, 18; a rock, Vikr. d. 49.
 2. A flat stone on which condiments are ground.
 3. Arsenic.
 II. f. ला and ली.
 1. A stone or beam placed across a post or pillar.
 2. The timber of a door frame.
 III. f. ली.
 1. A dart, an arrow, Ragh. 7, 62.
 2. An earth-worm.
 --Comp.

शील शील, i. e.
 A. शिष् + ल (m. and) n.
 1. Nature, quality. MBh. 1, 4054.
 2. Disposition, inclination, character, Pañc. i. d. 282; a good character, Pañc. v. d. 2.
 3. Moral practice, Man. 2, 6.
 4. Good conduct, Johns. Sel. 13, 45.
 5. Virtue, Bhartṛ. 2, 77.
 6. Beauty.
 B. शी + ल, m. A large snake.
 --Comp.

शिलाटक शिलाटक, m.
 1. A room on the top of a house.
 2. A hole.
शिलि and ली शिली̆ (cf. शिली, under शिल), f. The lower timber of a door.

शिलीन्ध्र शिलीन्ध्र,
 I. m.
 1. A sort of tree.
 2. A kind of fish.
 II. f. री.
 1. Clay, earth.
 2. A small earthworm (cf. शिली, under शिल).
 3. A sort of bird.
 III. n.
 1. Hail (cf. शिला).
 2. A mushroom, Megh. 11.
 3. The flower of the plantain tree.
शिलीपद शिलीपद (a dialect. form of श्लीपद, q. cf.), m. A morbid enlargement of the leg, Lass. 94, 10.

शिल्प शिल्प, n.
 1. Proficiency in any manual or mechanical art, or profession; art, Pañc. i. d. 4, 446; Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 17; Chr. 51, 1; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 12.
 2. A sort of spoon used at sacrifices to throw the butter into the fire.
 --Comp.

शिल्पिक शिल्पिक, i. e. शिल्प + इक,
 I. adj. Manual, mechanic.
 II. n.
 1. Handicraft.
 2. (and शिस्पक शिल्प + क), A sort of drama.

शिल्पिन् शिल्पिन्, i. e. शिल्प + इन्,
 I. adj. Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art.
 II. m., f. नी, and n. An artificer, a mechanic, Pañc. 10, 6; Johns. Sel. 9, 11.

शीलतस् शील + तस्, adv.
 1. By natural disposition, Pañc. i. d. 288.
 2. Concerning the character, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 8.
ऽशीलता -शील + ता, f. in त्याग-, Generosity, Hit. i. d. 104, M.M. शालीन-, f. Bashfulness, Utt. Rāmac. 173, 4.

शीलवन्त् शील + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Of a good disposition, Ragh. 10, 71.
 --Comp.
शिला- + सार शिला- + सार, m. iron.
